column1: Addresses of the reverse proxies in front of PHP (Varnish, the TLS terminator), one per line or comma separated. The client address is then read from X-Forwarded-For (rightmost address that is not a proxy). Leave empty when PHP sees the clients directly: the header is then ignored. Empty behind a proxy on a private network, the client is the forwarded address left after skipping the http_cache_hosts of env.php and at most one more hop in the proxy's subnet: a best effort that guesses the topology, so set the proxies in production.
